results.title: Review of ClearFeed by Kuldeep Dhankar | Product Hunt
results.content: August 29, 2025 - ClearFeed is highly praised for its ability to streamline Slack-based support, making it indispensable for companies with multiple channels. Users appreciate its responsiveness, customization options, and seamless integration with existing support

results.title: Review of ClearFeed by Ivy DeWitt | Product Hunt
results.content: May 27, 2025 - 5/5 - ClearFeed has been essential as a company that heavily focuses on Slack based support. They have provided service at all hours, even very late nights and their openness to customization is very much appreciated. Fantastic company and product.
